label: Avatar
desc: Registers an Avatar visual node (image, initials or custom content; sizes xsmall to xxlarge; borders, outlines and hover states) plus Avatar Group / Avatar Group Item components for overlapping avatar stacks driven by an Items array. Includes a Sample component demonstrating every variant. No longer bundles a Material Icons icon set — install the standalone Material Icons module if you want glyph avatars.

label: Chart.js
desc: A module with components to build charts.

label: Clipboard
desc: Copy any text to the user's clipboard. Ships a Copy To Clipboard node — set Text, fire Copy, and get Success/Failure signals plus an Error string. Uses navigator.clipboard.writeText in secure contexts (https/localhost) with an automatic document.execCommand('copy') fallback for plain-http and older browsers. No dependencies, no network.

label: Confetti
desc: A celebration trigger node — fire a burst, fireworks, side cannons or falling confetti over the page with one signal (canvas-confetti, MIT). Client-side; styleable count, spread, origin and colours.

label: Custom HTML
desc: Write your own HTML and pass values to it with template strings. Useful for embeds.

label: Data Context
desc: Share data between all child components.

label: Drag to Reorder
desc: Sortable list with drag-and-drop reordering, built directly on pointer events — mouse, touch and pen all work. Ships a Drag To Reorder node: feed it an Items array and it renders the rows; while dragging, the other rows translate out of the way and a drop indicator marks the target slot. Dropping outputs Reordered Items (a new array — the input is never mutated), From Index and To Index, then fires a Changed signal. Row colours come from design tokens and are stylable per instance. No dependencies, no network.

label: Example Node Kit
desc: A custom node you can read in one sitting. One React node whose every visual decision is a port — colour, spacing and size default to design tokens — plus the kit types, so your editor autocompletes the definition. Install it to see how a node kit is put together, then edit index.js and make it yours.

label: File Download
desc: A Download File logic node that saves any string to the user's machine as a real file — Blob + object URL, fully client-side, no dependencies. Wire To CSV's CSV output into Content, send Download, and get Done or Failure + Error. Filename and MIME Type inputs (text/plain default; use text/csv or application/json). Ships a demo component: Static Data → To CSV → Download File behind a button.

label: Font Awesome Brands
desc: The Font Awesome 6 brand icon library.

label: Font Awesome Solid
desc: The Font Awesome 6 solid icon library.

label: Form Validation
desc: A utility node that makes different kind of form validation easier.

label: Geospatial Analysis
desc: A module for using Turf.js to making it easy to working with GeoJSON.

label: GraphQL
desc: A module to help quering data using GraphQL.

label: i18next Translation
desc: A module for using i18next in Noodl.

label: Intl Format
desc: Locale-aware formatting nodes built on the browser's Intl APIs — no dependencies, no network. Relative Time turns a date into "3 hours ago" with an optional auto-refresh interval; Format Number handles decimal, currency and percent styles; Format List joins items with a localized conjunction or disjunction; Pluralize picks the right one/other form with Intl.PluralRules. Every node has a Locale input defaulting to the browser language, and every input is guarded — an unconnected input yields an empty string instead of throwing.

label: Lottie
desc: A module for using Lottie animations in Noodl.

label: Lucide Icons
desc: The Lucide open-source icon set (1998 glyphs, ISC licence) as a bundled webfont iconset — a community-friendly alternative to Material Icons.

label: MapLibre GL
desc: Interactive maps with zero configuration — a MapLibre Map node that renders the free MapLibre demo style out of the box (no access token, no account). Style URL, camera (longitude/latitude/zoom/bearing/pitch) and a Markers array are inputs; camera position, click coordinates and marker clicks are outputs. Bundles MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 (BSD-3-Clause).

label: Markdown
desc: Use Markdown in Noodl and style it with CSS.

label: Marquee
desc: Add a marquee container to your Noodl App.

label: Material Icons
desc: The latest material icon set library.

label: MQTT Module
desc: Send and receive messages over the MQTT protocol in web apps.

label: PDF Viewer
desc: A /PDF Viewer component that renders a PDF from a URL (PDF URL, Width and Height inputs) via Google's document viewer in an iframe. REQUIRES the standalone Custom HTML module — install that first; this entry no longer bundles its own copy of it. See the entry README.

label: QR Code
desc: Renders a QR code from any text or URL, fully client-side (qrcode-generator, MIT). Styleable size, quiet zone, foreground/background colours and error-correction level.

label: QR Scanner
desc: Scan QR codes from camera or images.

label: Rich Text Editor
desc: A WYSIWYG rich text editor node built on TipTap (MIT, vendored — fully offline, no CDN). Toolbar with bold, italic, headings H1–H3, bullet/ordered lists, links and undo/redo. Inputs: HTML (set content), Placeholder, Editable. Outputs: HTML, Text and a Changed signal on every edit. Toolbar and content chrome follow the app theme via design tokens.

label: Simple Tooltips
desc: Add simple tooltips to your Noodl App.

label: Virtual List
desc: Windowed rendering for big arrays: a Virtual List visual node keeps only the rows that intersect its viewport (plus an overscan margin) in the DOM, absolutely positioned over a full-height spacer, so a ten-thousand-row array scrolls smoothly where a Repeater stalls. Inputs: Items (array), Row Template ({{field}} text substitution), Item Height (fixed, px), Overscan, Height or Use Container Size. Outputs: First Visible Index, Visible Count. Ships a demo component with 10,000 generated rows.

label: Web Camera
desc: Support for accessing the camera in web apps.
